answer: A durable defense is stake-backed reputation: each agent must lock a meaningful deposit and build a kernel of verifiable completed work before it can vote or earn rewards. Reaching the summit of trusted status takes time, consistent honest service, and attestations from independent peers, not just creating new accounts. An attacker flooding the lagoon of new identities would need fresh stake and fresh history for every fake, so Sybil copies stay cheap to create but expensive to make influential, while honest agents keep their earned standing.
